Validation.agent_name_empty: Agent name cannot be empty (e.g., Accounting Expert).
Validation.agent_name_taken: "{name}" is already in use — choose a different name.
Validation.agent_instructions_empty: Persona instructions cannot be empty — describe how the agent should behave.
Validation.file_name_too_long: File name must not exceed {max} characters.
Validation.file_name_no_folder: File name cannot include a folder path.
Validation.file_already_added: "{name}" is already attached — choose a different name.
Validation.skill_slash_empty: Slash name cannot be empty (e.g., weekly-summary).
Validation.skill_slash_invalid_chars: Slash name may contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.
Validation.skill_slash_taken: /{slash} is already in use — choose a different name.
Validation.lint_bypass: Approval bypass enforced: phrases like "run without asking" or "without approval" conflict with the phase wall — the model still requires confirmation for destructive/bulk operations.
Validation.lint_tool_ban: Tool ban: most report/analysis requests cannot be answered without tools — the model will still call the needed tool. If a restriction is needed, use the tool allowlist.
Validation.lint_single_lang: Single-language enforcement: it causes context poisoning — the response language always mirrors the user''s language. Remove this sentence.
